reply: I did not find the exact law. The best candidate, NMSE 1.37e-10, is an 9-parameter fit that is not clean: dA/dt ≈ −0.18·A²·√t + g(t), where g(t) is a mixed combination of 1/t, log t, √t, t, t², t^1.5 and a constant. The A²·√t term is well pinned at 0.18, but g(t) is not identified in closed form.
